implementation: Preserve selected reference-free IMAGEDEF XDATA groups with bounded ASCII APPID/text, balanced controls, finite scalar values and signed numeric ranges. Register required APPID names before writing objects, deduplicating the built-in ACAD and LibreCad names and case-insensitive shared names. Application groups and XDATA share a four-MiB logical capture budget; unsupported groups, missing or nondefault typed source APPID rows, and metadata invalidated by path edits are reported.
validation: A new source-XDATA assertion failed before implementation. Fifteen focused IMAGE, dictionary and paper-space tests and eighteen layout tests pass afterward.

Tests cover custom and built-in APPIDs, case-insensitive reuse across definitions, duplicate groups, handle and layer references, long text and names, unbalanced controls, signed numeric limits, source APPID flags/application data and a missing source APPID. Unsupported groups are dropped as a whole while eligible groups survive; changed-path loss and corrected same-writer retry are checked.
A locally generated 160-definition control exhausts the shared logical metadata budget; emitted XDATA groups contain either all 120 text values or none, and dropped metadata is reported.

Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 reads the generated R2000 source and its ASCII and binary outputs with two IMAGEs linked to one IMAGEDEF. Selected XDATA groups, nested control tokens, numbers and APPID registrations agree; all three audit with zero errors and zero fixes.
The adapter syntax-checks with older bundled codec headers; their runtime behavior is not qualified.
limits: APPID rows are regenerated by name; the typed source check does not prove original physical-row completeness, source-handle remapping or arbitrary inbound references. Nondefault or unavailable typed metadata is reported.

Layer and handle references, binary/coordinate XDATA, non-ASCII encodings, full source IMAGE dictionary and reactor identity, external producers and native rendering remain unqualified. The budget accounts logical payload and estimated nodes rather than process memory. Generated drawings remain scratch-only.
